EVERYDAY ADVENTURES

Practise familiar moments.

Virtual scenes create opportunities to explore safety and routines in a repeatable environment. Take related activities into everyday family life, at your child's pace.

PLAY WITH PURPOSE

Curiosity comes first.

Practice areas include social communication, emotional recognition, attention, cognitive skills and sensory regulation. Adaptive difficulty and customisable plans help match activities to individual needs.

Connected to your family.

Training records help families and supporting professionals review practice over time. Activity scores describe performance in the task; they are not an autism diagnosis or proof of everyday improvement.

Follow the journey together

Automatic training records and visual summaries help families and supporting professionals review participation and task performance. Optional remote guidance depends on your service arrangement; it is not included unless confirmed.

Made by YIWEI Medical

LumiBrain™ draws on YIWEI Medical’s VR, eye-tracking and adaptive digital training platform. Supplied product materials describe immersive practice, individual activity plans, progress records and connected home-to-centre workflows.

Know what you are buying

Listed home package: equipment rental plus a 12-month subscription. Confirm headset suitability, exact equipment, rental period, deposit, return conditions, shipping destination and the PayPal item/amount with support before payment. Published research relates to other systems; no guaranteed outcome is offered.
